title: BTCX (BTToken) burn-from-pair + pair.sync() — permissionless but self-limited; pool is one-way (buys revert T0)
closed_reasons: burn is fixed-rate (~0.104%/hour of the pair's real BTCX balance), capped at 1 cycle/hour, no per-tx loop
the pool is one-way: any transfer with from==pancakePair reverts "T0", so a fresh attacker cannot acquire BTCX
redeem returns 0 BTCX if held <60 days (100% burned), so deposit+redeem cannot obtain BTCX either
key_facts: gate = revert("T0") when from==pancakePair in _transferWithLogic — blocks all buys
caveats: point-in-time 2026-10-22; BTCB USD is DefiLlama spot
latent: if the token were dormant >100h a single tx replays 100 cycles (~9.9% of pair BTCX) — still non-extractable (unbuyable)
adjacent tokenExt.processBuildLP / _redeem accounting not evaluated (different bug class)
one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live; the burn-from-pair+sync() is real and permissionless but fixed-rate/self-limited and the pool cannot be bought out (revert T0), so the $2.46M BTCB is unreachable to an outsider
